rows.label: How boldly the hero fights
rows.help: How far the hero notices and chases monsters and how early it backs off. It moves existing fight settings together: how far away a monster is noticed, how long a chase lasts, the life lines for potions and for leaving the game, extra care against champions, and when the potion count sends the hero to town. A melee hero and a caster get different numbers for the same stance (sheet: Knobs).

options.label: Cautious
options.says: Cautious: only fights what comes close (noticed within about 4 tiles for a melee hero, 5 for a caster), gives up a chase sooner, drinks a healing potion at 65 percent life, leaves the game at 35 percent, takes extra care with champions and goes to town when 3 healing potions are left.

options.label: Balanced
options.says: Balanced: today's behaviour. Monsters within 6 tiles are fought, a healing potion at 55 percent life, the game is left at 25 percent, a town trip at 2 healing potions.

options.label: Aggressive
options.says: Aggressive: goes after monsters from farther away (about 8 tiles for a melee hero, 7 for a caster), chases longer, drinks at 50 percent life, leaves the game at 22 percent (20 for a caster), takes less extra care with champions and goes to town only when 1 healing potion is left. A melee hero starts here: it has to walk up to its target.
